author: Myv
body:
Hello, Sandbox is an old 4TDM map that WishiWashii, 89P and I made a couple of months ago and we are reuploading it due to the recent Deathmatch rotations being added and altered in game.

Creators: 89P (iMan), WishiWashii (Raikkou) and r8ys (Myv)

Map Information

Team Sizes: 8v8v8v8
Team Colours: Red, Yellow, Purple and Green
Time Limit: 10 minutes

Other Information

Download: Has been done, will be added once I find the file lol
XML: Will be done if necessary.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/LbtvF
Thank you for taking the time to view our map.

Myv, Raikkou and iMan

PLEASE NOTE: The spawns show in the album are not the correct spawns. They have been altered and are better in my opinion, if you would like to see them then I will add them to the album.
